description: Compute the exact edits to rename a content-type / service / controller / policy / middleware / component: every magic-string call-site and route handler, plus the file/folder renames. Dry-run: returns a plan (edits + `planId`, + `warnings` listing the UIDs Strapi also stores in the database — permissions, media links, components — which the plan does not migrate; with config-sync, the plan also updates the sync files of those permissions and views unless `configSync: false`, and says which), writes nothing. Review, then apply with `apply_edits` (pass the `planId`).

configSync.description: With strapi-plugin-config-sync: also update the config/sync files this refactor concerns (roles' permissions, content-manager views) to the new names. Default: true (the strapiDevkit.configSync.followRefactors setting; DEVKIT_CONFIG_SYNC_FOLLOW_REFACTORS=0 for a standalone server). Pass false when config/sync is not yours to change here (exported from another environment). The plan's warnings say which sync files it updates, or leaves with the old names.

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

newName.description: The UID's new last segment, e.g. item (api::product.product → api::product.item, shared.seo → shared.item)

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

ref.description: The entity UID/ref, e.g. api::product.product or shared.seo

name: plan_rename_entity
title: Plan an entity rename (dry-run)
